when: Caller is angry or very upset in general terms.
examples: this is ridiculous
I am so fed up with this
this is the worst service ever
I can't believe how bad this is

examples: this is the third time I'm calling
I keep having the same problem
nobody has fixed this yet

why does everything take so long

well?

hmm
